coincident/04-arc-vs-cubic-circle.union: Correct now, but slow: ~9.4s per operation, all of it in intersection finding. The arc and the cubic approximating it stay within a whisker of each other along a whole quadrant, so their boxes overlap everywhere and the subdivision explores an enormous number of leaf pairs to return 3 points per pair. Needs the finder to recognize that two curves run together within tolerance over a stretch, rather than bisecting its way along it.
